checkpoints.label: Planner command center
checkpoints.action: Scan both active wedding cards, then choose Manage for Sofia & Daniel.
checkpoints.visibleResult: Two active weddings show populated progress and Sofia & Daniel is the connected story to follow.

checkpoints.label: Wedding event source
checkpoints.action: Open Events and inspect the Traditional event venue and 4:00 PM start time.
checkpoints.visibleResult: The planner source record shows The Glasshouse at Riverbend and the 4:00 PM event time.

checkpoints.label: Public event plan
checkpoints.action: Manually switch to the prepared public tab and inspect the same event details.
checkpoints.visibleResult: The public schedule shows The Glasshouse at Riverbend and 4:00 PM without planner controls.

checkpoints.label: Couple timeline
checkpoints.action: Manually switch to the prepared couple tab, open Timeline, and inspect the same event.
checkpoints.visibleResult: The couple Timeline shows the same Glasshouse venue and 4:00 PM plan in its guided portal.

checkpoints.label: Guest response context
checkpoints.action: Return to the planner tab, open Guests, and filter the seeded table to Declined.
checkpoints.visibleResult: The planner sees the Declined slice as operational context for the same wedding.

checkpoints.label: Return to command center
checkpoints.action: Return to the planner command center and pause on the connected portfolio.
checkpoints.visibleResult: The two active weddings and their next actions remain visible.
